purpose: Teach: 実地/旅費/引数/業態/格付け/送迎/旅客/打ち込ん

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、実地訓練、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We at the police department are genuinely committed to conducting thorough field training exercises. We appreciate your cooperation.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Measured cadence with slight formality. Opens with quiet authority. Firm commitment without urgency. Closes with genuine respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察出張の旅費、本気で、絶対、当社、絶対、補助、絶対、お申し付けください、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, understood. Our company will absolutely handle the travel expenses for any police training visits. Please let us know what you need.
lines.style: Responsive and eager. Steady, reliable delivery. Slightly faster than the officer's pace. Warm professionalism—showing readiness without overstepping.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害届の引数、本気で、絶対、正確に、絶対、ご記入ください、本気で、感謝
lines.en: When you file a damage report, please make sure to fill in all the details accurately. That information is important to us.
lines.style: Clear, direct instruction. Even pacing. No rush, but no ambiguity either. Precise articulation on key procedural points.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新業態の防犯、本気で、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご指導、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, absolutely. We'd be grateful for the police department's guidance as we develop security measures for our new business operations.
lines.style: Respectful and attentive. Slightly slower, showing careful consideration of the request. Genuine openness to guidance without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の格付け、本気で、絶対、市民、絶対、信頼、絶対、寄せていただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The public's trust in the police force is something we've seen grow steadily. We're grateful for your continued dedication to that.
lines.style: Thoughtful and steady. Acknowledges the weight of the statement. Calm, measured delivery with quiet emphasis on 'trust.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察送迎の、本気で、絶対、車両、絶対、当社で、絶対、用意可能です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company is happy to arrange transportation for any police department visits. We can provide vehicles whenever needed.
lines.style: Helpful and practical. Warm tone, forward-leaning slightly. Offering assistance with quiet confidence. Quick and capable.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 旅客機の安全、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、見守ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The safety of passengers on commercial flights is something we all take seriously. The police department will continue to monitor and protect that.
lines.style: Measured, serious tone. Slight weight on the responsibility being stated. Steady, unhurried. Conviction without dramatic emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、防犯活動に、絶対、打ち込んでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our staff is committed to supporting crime prevention efforts in every way we can. Thank you for this partnership.
lines.style: Sincere commitment. Warm closer. Slightly softer attack than previous responses. Genuine gratitude in the final words, not perfunctory.
